senses.definition: n.pr.m. a priest of Zerubbabel’s time according to Ne 12:5; 𝔊א Μααδιας, 𝔊L Μαασιας; appar.=מוֹעַדְיָה v 17, 𝔊L Μασαι (etym. dub.; Thes puts sub עדה=ornamentum Jovae, but proposes מֹע׳=מוֹע׳, √ יעד=conventus Jovae).
